captions.detailed: A vintage-style box fan with a beige/tan plastic housing, featuring a top carrying handle and a dark brown ribbed speed knob. The fan contains a central cylindrical motor housing supporting a four-blade propeller on a continuous revolute joint. A silver-colored wire safety grille is mounted behind the blades, supported by diagonal structural struts extending from the square outer frame.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a vintage box fan with a tan-colored rectangular housing, a top handle, a dark brown speed dial, a wire grille, and a central four-blade propeller that rotates continuously on a revolute joint.
captions.factory: The model is built using an ArticulatedObject. First, the main frame is constructed by extruding a hollowed-out square profile with rounded corners, adding a top handle using a swept circle along an arc, and placing a fluted control knob on the top right. Next, the rear wire grille is modeled with concentric circles intersected by radial lines. The propeller is constructed as a separate part containing a central hub cylinder and four angled rectangular blades. Finally, a continuous revolute joint is defined along the central Y-axis to connect the rotating propeller to the static fan frame.
